source.title: Admit principal-held compute with zero new cash and explicit entitlement headroom
source.body:
## Leader instruction — 2026-10-21 (America/Chicago)
> make more money: do more faster with more compute without spending more cash.

**Original competent source:** this repository's `src/compute-work-hiring.mjs` and `quote-compute-work`; original upstream monetary math is `src/pricing.mjs`. Consume rather than fork the [existing installed-supplier receiving work #4](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/capability-pricing-service/issues/4), [Coesite original compute/Bazaar Work](https://github.com/coesite-operations/capability-market-services-section/issues/5), [Group paid-Work sourcing](https://github.com/561-group/561-group-opportunity-services-section/issues/35), and [Gathering the Mist receiving](https://github.com/561-group/561-group-opportunity-services-section/issues/3).

### Specific defect and requirement
Present `compareComputeWorkOffers` correctly refuses omitted costs, unsupported commercial rights, underbilled GPU seconds, unverified same-task reliability and uncertain pricing. But it cannot represent **full positive economic shadow/resource cost with $0 marginal new cash** when the requester already controls fixed-paid compute entitlements. Provider sticker price, historical fixed commitments, cash outlay, opportunity cost, GPU headroom, and customer income are distinct facts.

- **NC-01** Source-own an *optional* principal-held-capacity comparison branch within the existing exact-rational quote method (not a new market or scheduler). Preserve existing external paid-provider behavior.
- **NC-02** Require a bounded original Work principal, per-kind cash disposition for all 12 resource-cost categories, source-bound exact consumption quantity, evidence of rightful original account/entitlement and sufficient uncommitted usable capacity to cover retry-adjusted demand. Treat data as attributed source assertions, not independently verified reservations.
- **NC-03** Apply a same-denomination exact *new cash ceiling* independent of total economic quote. A ceiling of zero must refuse any positive additional cash, unclassified cost, expired/wrong-principal entitlement, exhausted headroom, forbidden relationship, unknown rights, incompatible workload or uncertain source.
- **NC-04** Return comparable price-per-accepted-result and modeled incremental cash-per-accepted-result as **separate** quantities; never equate a cash-free internal allocation with free compute, margin, sales, settled payouts, or external buyer acceptance.
- **NC-05** Prove the distinction on executable native tests: (a) a source-asserted eligible previously funded capacity option within a zero-new-cash cap, (b) a nominally cheaper billable provider refused, (c) wrong principal/expired or insufficient quota refused, (d) retry-adjusted quota and cash, (e) unchanged original procurement behavior.

**Receiving:** source/Node tests alone are not live capacity or income. Follow [the original CFO financial-stewardship procedure](https://github.com/561-group/561-group-services-section) and Coesite installed Work before calling it operational. A real positive outcome needs original source/custody/rights and current provider usage measurement, accepted external Work, distinct buyer charge/settlement and seller attribution, with zero **additional** cash expenditure established from the authoritative bill/ledger. No external provider order, account enrollment, billable API request or scheduled task is authorized by this issue.
